paper_title: First results from the WISPDMX radio frequency cavity searches for hidden photon dark matter
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless (plot shows log10(chi); values emitted as linear chi)
notes: WISPDMX first science run: haloscope search for hidden photon dark matter using tunable 208 MHz HERA RF cavity (four modes TM010, TE111-1, TE111-2, TM020). Paper reports 95% CL exclusion limits at chi ~ 1e-13 in resonant tuning ranges (0.8602-0.8646 ueV, 1.3088-1.3358 ueV, 1.8820-1.8977 ueV) and chi ~ 1e-12 for the broadband range 0.2-2.07 ueV, steadily weakening down to 0.4 neV. Exact limit curves are shown in Figs. 18-19 but no numerical table is provided; data points here are approximate reconstructions from the text-quoted levels. The resonant dips at 1e-13 and the low-mass rise (value at 0.4 neV is an order-of-magnitude estimate) are schematic. Assumes rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, isotropic HP flux direction, vesc = 530 km/s. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.65, 41)) | Vision: Boundary traced from Fig. 19 (combined resonant+broadband 95% CL limits, blue region; excluded region above/inside). X-axis is log10(m_gamma' in eV) from -10 to 0; y-axis log10(chi) from -16 to -4. Broadband envelope is smooth/wedge-shaped, deepening from chi~1e-7 at ~2e-8 eV to ~5e-13 near 2 ueV; three deep resonant spikes (208, 320, 456 MHz modes; Fig. 18 floors chi~5-7e-14) at 8.6e-7, 1.32e-6, 1.89e-6 eV are included. Low-mass tail (0.4-10 neV) has weak, spiky limits chi~1e-6 to 1e-4; envelope there is approximate.
